description:
Create a new investment portfolio in Portfolio Performance. Using the File menu, create a new portfolio file with the following specifications:

1. Set the base currency to USD
2. Create a securities account named 'Retirement Account'
3. Create a linked cash/deposit account named 'Retirement Account (USD)'
4. Save the portfolio as 'retirement_portfolio.xml' in the /home/ga/Documents/PortfolioData/ directory

The portfolio should be empty (no securities or transactions yet) - just the account structure needs to be set up correctly.
